description: This file defines a DefaultImportTracker struct and associated methods for managing import paths and names in Go code generation, specifically for tracking and generating import statements for types and symbols.

classes.name: DefaultImportTracker
classes.description: A struct for tracking import paths and names, managing import lines, and resolving local names and paths for code generation.

methods.name: AddTypes
methods.description: Adds multiple types to the import tracker.

methods.name: AddSymbol
methods.description: Adds a symbol's package to the import tracker if it is not from the local package.

methods.name: AddType
methods.description: Adds a type to the import tracker, considering whether it is invalid or a built-in.

methods.name: ImportLines
methods.description: Generates the import statements for all tracked import paths.

methods.name: LocalNameOf
methods.description: Returns the local name used to refer to a package at a given path.

methods.name: PathOf
methods.description: Returns the import path associated with a given local name.
